reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin whose primary purpose is adding a theme-aware peak-hours status badge and language setting to the session header using local time calculations.

summaries.zh: 在会话顶栏显示基于北京时间的高峰时段状态徽章，并支持语言选择、主题适配和自动刷新。
summaries.en: Displays a theme-aware peak-hours status badge in the session header using Beijing time, with language selection and automatic refresh.

capabilities: Computes and displays Beijing time and peak-hour status
Adds a status badge and language setting to the session interface
Persists the badge language through a local host settings channel
Refreshes the displayed status every 15 seconds
